evidence: Path coverage is high but coverage isn't specificity.
observation: Of the 15,430 target-disease pairs, a typed two-hop path exists through shared GO for 91.1%, phenotype for 83.2%, pathway for 80.0%, tissue (High/Medium) for 69.8% and thresholded PPI for 41.9%; any typed path covers 91.1%. Coverage is the explainability ceiling of a layer, not its quality.
subject: F-93
title: Typed two-hop path coverage per context layer
